rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Margin (%) = Net Profit / Revenue x 100

note: Rebuilt 15 Nov 2026. Each year was accepted only where two independent compilers reproduced the same net profit within 1 percent (or 1,000 EGP) for that fiscal year, and revenue exceeded gross profit. Earlier Mubasher summary columns for this issuer did not reconcile with either compiler and were replaced. Cost of Sales is derived as Revenue minus Gross Profit.
